explanation.headline: Zoledronic acid is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Corvale East has 11 days on hand and Corvale General has 31.7 days on hand

sentences.text: FDA's records show zoledronic acid is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 36 vials of the 4 mg/100 mL presentation with 3.3 vials used per day, giving 11 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 89 vials of the same presentation with 2.8 vials used per day, giving 31.7 days on hand.
The product label for NDC 68083014201 names Gland Pharma Limited as the manufacturing plant (FEI 3002647489) in India.
FDA inspection 1244548 at that plant ended 2024-07-25 and was classified VAI, with the classification known on 2025-01-15.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Accord Healthcare Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose label names no plant we could place.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
